Committed as `f2b68c1` on `feat/adapter-batch-public-boards`. Not pushed, no PR opened, per instructions.

## Summary

**Built:**
- `src/lib/sources/wellfound.ts` — `auth:"browser-session"`, calls `withBrowserSession()` twice (once per role URL), extracts listings via a pure recursive walk of the parsed `__NEXT_DATA__` JSON tree for `title`/`slug`-keyed objects, deduped by slug. No relevance filtering anywhere in the file. Throws on: missing `sessionStatePath` config, missing/empty/invalid-JSON `__NEXT_DATA__` tag, and zero listings across both pages — never a silent `[]`.
- `src/lib/sources/origins.ts` — added `wellfound: ["wellfound.com"]` to `SOURCE_ORIGINS` and `wellfound: "https://wellfound.com/login"` to `SOURCE_LOGIN_URLS`.
- `src/lib/apply/runner.ts` — added `wellfound.js` to the dynamic-import list so `npm run radar` picks it up.
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` — roadmap entry, `SOURCE_ORIGINS` example, and Capture-Login-button description updated.
- Did **not** touch any real `config.json` (per the story's explicit design decision).

**Data honesty — important finding:** I could not get real fixture data. Live-checked `https://wellfound.com/role/l/chief-technology-officer` and `.../vp-of-engineering` (the two URLs this story and the legacy tool specify) with zero session/cookies — both return a genuine HTTP 404 today. I re-checked 8 different `/role/l/<slug>` paths; all 404. The entire URL scheme appears to have been retired in a Wellfound site restructuring since the legacy tool was built. What I *did* live-confirm: the real `/login` route (title exactly "Log In | Wellfound", body containing "Continue with Google" — used as the auth-failure signal) and the `<script id="__NEXT_DATA__">` mechanism itself (captured a real envelope from the 404 error page). A company-jobs page fetch to see real listing JSON was blocked by a Cloudflare Turnstile challenge (403). So `src/lib/sources/__tests__/fixtures/wellfound-next-data.json` is a **clearly-labeled synthetic fixture** — I did not pretend it was real. This is documented prominently in `wellfound.ts`'s file-level comment and in `ARCHITECTURE.md`, with a standing follow-up for the owner (re-verify the current correct board URL, then a real Capture Login), mirroring the existing precedent for `ateam.ts`'s deferred live verification.

**Tests:** 15 new tests in `src/lib/sources/__tests__/wellfound.test.ts` covering correct Gig[] mapping/dedup/company-extraction, the missing-`__NEXT_DATA__`-tag failure, the missing-session-file error path, and the origin allowlist. Also loosened two `origins.test.ts` assertions that had hard-pinned `SOURCE_ORIGINS` to exactly `{gofractional, ateam}` (would have broken on any future adapter addition) — converted to subset checks matching the pattern `KNOWN_SOURCES` already uses, plus added wellfound-specific assertions.

**Verification:** `npm test` — 431 passed, 3 skipped, 0 failed. `npm run typecheck` — clean. `npm run build` — clean. Full-suite regression check passed (this being the epic's last story).

**Commit:** `f2b68c1` on `feat/adapter-batch-public-boards`.
